title: iDisco Immunolabeling in Brown Adipose Tissue (BAT)
author: Seoeun Lee
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.wqmfdu6
materials: The cleared sample should be tranferred to a chamber of an appropriate size (we create one with a 3D printer), sealed on a coverglass with Kwik-sil epoxy (VWR). This chamber is then mounted on Attofluor cell chamber (Thermofisher A7816) and filled with DBE

steps.title: Perfuse mouse with fixative
steps.instruction: Anesthetize the mouse and perfuse with 20 ml of saline followed by 20 ml of 4 % paraformaldehyde (PFA) in 0.1 M phosphate buffer (PB).

steps.title: Dissect brown adipose tissue
steps.instruction: Dissect the brown adipose tissue (BAT), carefully removing surrounding white adipose tissue; the two bilateral depots may be left connected or separated as desired.

steps.title: Fix tissue overnight
steps.instruction: Fix the dissected BAT in 4 % PFA in 0.1 M PB at 4 °C overnight with shaking, then incubate at room temperature (RT) for 1 hour.

steps.title: PBS washes
steps.instruction: Wash the tissue in PBS with shaking at RT for 30 minutes, repeat three times.

substeps.instruction: Remove PBS, repeat two more washes.

steps.title: Methanol dehydration series
steps.instruction: Dehydrate the sample through methanol/H₂O series (20 %, 40 %, 60 %, 80 %, 100 %) at RT for 1 hour each with shaking.

steps.title: Final methanol wash and chill
steps.instruction: Wash further with 100 % methanol for 1 hour at RT, then chill the sample at 4 °C with shaking.

steps.title: DCM/methanol overnight incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate the sample overnight with shaking in a solution of 66 % dichloromethane (DCM) / 33 % methanol / 1 % deionized water at RT.

steps.title: Methanol washes and chill
steps.instruction: Wash twice in 100 % methanol at RT with shaking, then chill the sample at 4 °C.

steps.title: Bleach in H₂O₂/methanol
steps.instruction: Bleach in chilled fresh 5 % H₂O₂ in methanol (mix 1 volume 30 % H₂O₂ with 5 volumes methanol) overnight at 4 °C with shaking.

steps.title: Rehydrate methanol series
steps.instruction: Rehydrate through methanol/H₂O series (80 %, 60 %, 40 %, 20 %, then PBS) at RT for 1 hour each with shaking.

steps.title: PTx.2 washes
steps.instruction: Wash in PTx.2 (0.2 % Triton X‑100 in PBS) for 1 hour, repeat twice at RT with shaking.

substeps.instruction: First 1 h wash in PTx.2, RT, shake.
Second 1 h wash in PTx.2, RT, shake.

steps.title: Permeabilization incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate samples in permeabilization solution (40 ml PTx.2 + 10 ml DMSO + 1.15 g glycine) at 37 °C with shaking for 2 days.

steps.title: Blocking incubation
steps.instruction: Block in blocking solution (42 ml PT2.x + 3 ml donkey serum + 5 ml DMSO) at 37 °C with shaking for 2 days.

steps.title: Primary antibody incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate with primary antibody diluted in PTwH (0.2 % Tween‑20 in PBS + 0.1 % of 10 mg ml⁻¹ heparin stock) containing 5 % DMSO and 3 % donkey serum at 37 °C with shaking for 7 days. Validated antibodies: β‑III tubulin (Abcam ab18207, 1:400), tyrosine hydroxylase (Millipore AB152, 1:400), PGP9.5 (Abcam ab108986, 1:400).

steps.title: Primary antibody washes
steps.instruction: Wash in PTwH 4–5 times (1–2 hours each) with shaking at RT until the next day.

steps.title: Secondary antibody preparation and incubation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge secondary antibody at 20 000 g for 10 minutes, keep in amber tube, then incubate in PTwH with 3 % donkey serum at 37 °C with shaking for 7 days. Use fluorophores with emission > 555 nm (e.g., AF555, AF647).

substeps.instruction: Incubate in PTwH + 3 % donkey serum, 37 °C, shake, 7 days.

steps.title: Secondary antibody washes
steps.instruction: Wash in PTwH 4–5 times (1–2 hours each) with shaking at RT until the next day.

steps.title: Final methanol dehydration
steps.instruction: Dehydrate through methanol/H₂O series (20 %, 40 %, 60 %, 80 %, 100 %) at RT for 1 hour each with shaking; optional overnight incubation at this point is allowed.

steps.title: 66 % DCM incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate with shaking for 3 hours in 66 % DCM / 33 % methanol / 1 % deionized water at RT.

steps.title: Double DCM wash
steps.instruction: Incubate twice in 100 % DCM for 15 minutes each at RT with shaking to remove methanol.

substeps.instruction: First 15 min DCM wash, RT, shake.
Second 15 min DCM wash, RT, shake.

steps.title: DBE clearing
steps.instruction: Incubate in DiBenzyl Ether (DBE) without shaking; fill the tube almost completely with DBE to prevent air oxidation, then invert the tube a few times before imaging.
